turns.prompt_text: I'm going to the Iowa State Fair tomorrow and we were wondering if they allow electric scooters there?
turns.response_html:
The Iowa State Fair generally does not allow personal electric scooters (like stand-up e-scooters or recreational hoverboards) for general transportation on the fairgrounds.

However, the Fair does permit specific Other Power-Driven Mobility Devices (OPDMDs) for individuals with mobility-related needs.

Rules for Personal Mobility Devices

If you have a mobility-related disability and wish to bring your own device, it must meet the following criteria to be permitted in pedestrian areas:

  • Design: It must be a three- or four-wheeled device.
  • Usage: It must be designed by the manufacturer for single-rider use only and be occupied by only one person.
  • Speed: It must be operated at a walking pace.
  • Restrictions: It cannot be pulling or towing any type of trailer.

Rental Options & Assistance

If you need help navigating the large fairgrounds, there are several official options available:

  • Scooter Rentals: You can rent mobility scooters directly at the Fair at Gates 8, 10, 11, 13, and 15. It is recommended to reserve them in advance through HomeTown Mobility.
  • NEW for 2026 – Mobility Assistance Carts: The Fair now offers complimentary rides on volunteer-operated, six-seat golf carts.
    • Hours: Daily from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.
    • Service: They travel along fixed routes between five designated Information Booth locations (Gate 11, Gate 10, Cattle Barn area, Grand Avenue near the Bud Tent, and near Gate 4/Fire Station).

If you were planning to bring a recreational electric scooter simply to get around faster, you will likely be asked to leave it at your vehicle or secured outside the gates. Bicycle parking is available for free inside Gate 13 if you choose to cycle to the Fair instead.
